verdict.rationale: Mailgun has a public pricing page (mailgun.com/pricing) listing at least a free allowance ('100 emails per day included') and plan features such as dedicated IP pools, so some pricing is self-serve. The evidence shows no dollar amounts for volume tiers, no overage rates and no add-on prices, so a founder could not fully price the service from what is cited. missing for 10: published per-volume tier prices, overage rates, dedicated IP add-on cost, email validation pricing, confirmation that no sales call is needed, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can price the service from the public site alone — per-volume tiers, overage rates, and add-on costs (dedicated IPs, validation) published without a sales call
